apps.name: WildFocus
apps.tagline: Turn your focus sessions into a pet collection.
apps.description: Every timer you complete earns you a new creature. Beat procrastination one Pomodoro at a time.

problem: Most productivity apps treat focus like a chore. You set a timer, stare at a countdown, and feel guilty every time you break it. The discipline is all stick, no carrot.
Procrastination isn't a willpower failure — it's a motivation problem. When the reward for finishing a task is just… the next task, it's hard to start at all.
solution: WildFocus adds a tangible reward loop to the Pomodoro technique. Complete a focus session and you earn a random pet — common, rare, or legendary. Your collection grows with your focus streak.

It keeps everything on your device. No account required, no notifications from a server, no data leaving your phone. The gamification is lightweight and honest — it's there to help you build a habit, not to hook you into the app.

features.title: Focus Timer
features.text: Configurable Pomodoro-style sessions with custom durations and break reminders.

features.title: Pet Collection
features.text: Earn a random pet after each session. Common, rare, epic, and legendary tiers.

features.title: Daily Streaks
features.text: Track your daily focus habit and protect your streak with consistency.

features.title: Achievements
features.text: Unlock milestones for total sessions, streak lengths, and rare pet discoveries.

features.title: Daily Challenges
features.text: Optional daily goals that reward bonus tokens for completing extra sessions.

features.title: Local Notifications
features.text: Streak reminders and session nudges, scheduled entirely on your device — no server involved.

features.title: Private by Design
features.text: No account, no analytics, no ads. All data stays on your device. Export / import any time.

features.title: Light & Dark Mode
features.text: Follows system theme or set it manually. Works comfortably at any time of day.

apps.name: MealCart
apps.tagline: From recipe to shopping list in one tap.
apps.description: Turn any recipe into a ready-to-shop list in seconds, grouped by aisle.

problem: Writing grocery lists by hand means retyping every recipe, adding up quantities in your head, and still walking the supermarket three times for the thing you forgot.
solution: MealCart turns any recipe into a structured shopping list automatically — paste a URL, scan a photo, or type it in. Plan a week of dinners on Sunday and MealCart merges everything into one list, deduplicates quantities, and groups items by aisle so you shop in one pass.

features.title: Recipe import
features.text: Paste any recipe URL or scan a photo to pull in the ingredients instantly.

features.title: Smart shopping list
features.text: Quantities merged and deduplicated across every recipe you plan.

features.title: Weekly meal plan
features.text: Drag recipes onto a weekly grid and shop for the whole week at once.

features.title: Pantry tracker
features.text: Mark what you already own and keep it off the list automatically.

features.title: Aisle grouping
features.text: Items sorted by store section, so you move through the supermarket once.

features.title: Servings scaler
features.text: Adjust portions and watch every quantity recalculate in real time.

features.title: Macro tracking
features.text: Calories, protein, carbs and fat for every planned meal.
